# Additional official source check: named Taipei bin-removal locations

Search run: 2026-10-18 (Asia/Taipei). Scope limited to eight result-search queries for Raohe/Songshan, Nangang/Kunyang, and named parks, then four opened primary official pages. The LTN link below was checked only as a secondary lead and could not be opened. No people were contacted and no repository files were changed.

## Search log

1. `site:gaz.tcc.gov.tw 饒河夜市 松山車站 垃圾桶 果皮箱 撤除`
2. `site:dep.gov.taipei 饒河夜市 松山站 果皮箱 移除`
3. `site:gaz.tcc.gov.tw 南港車站 南港轉運站 昆陽站 果皮箱 撤除`
4. `site:dep.gov.taipei 南港站 昆陽站 行人果皮箱 移除`
5. `site:gaz.tcc.gov.tw "大安森林公園" "果皮箱" 移除 撤除`
6. `site:gaz.tcc.gov.tw "青年公園" 果皮箱 撤除`
7. `site:gaz.tcc.gov.tw "芝山公園" OR "福林公園" 行人果皮箱 撤除`
8. `site:gaz.tcc.gov.tw "志成公園" 果皮箱 移除`

The first four searches returned general DEP policy/team pages, not named-place removal records. Searches 5–8 returned no results. This is bounded search failure, not proof that no such records exist.

## Primary pages opened

- [DEP FAQ: 申請清潔箱新設、拆除、遷移](https://www.dep.gov.taipei/News_Content.aspx?n=ACEFA960B5A4ACD7&s=B90A10FBBF73521B), page updated 2026-09-29 (ROC 115-09-29). It says requests can be raised through a borough chief or 1999, and the DEP cleaning team assesses whether removal or relocation is appropriate; placement is assessed by sidewalk width, pedestrian volume, and traffic effects. It gives the process, not any event/place/date/reason for the requested sites.
- [DEP Songshan District Cleaning Team](https://www.dep.gov.taipei/News_Content.aspx?n=ACBF29804BAC5495&s=08E00A9320F54104&sms=C20609053DE74727), accessed 2026-10-18. It lists pedestrian cleaning-box maintenance as a district team duty and a waste-removal duty for Raohe Street. This establishes operational responsibility only, not removal/restoration at Raohe Night Market or Songshan Station.
- [DEP Nangang District Cleaning Team](https://www.dep.gov.taipei/News_Content.aspx?n=ACBF29804BAC5495&s=D88AC980C3BFF678&sms=C20609053DE74727), accessed 2026-10-18. It lists pedestrian cleaning-box cleaning/collection duties across Nangang teams. It does not name Nangang Station, Nangang Bus Station, Kunyang Station, or any removal event.
- [DEP Directly Managed Cleaning Team](https://www.dep.gov.taipei/News_Content.aspx?n=ACBF29804BAC5495&s=7BF4AC711A54C143&sms=C20609053DE74727), accessed 2026-10-18. It assigns citywide bin installation, removal, relocation, and repair as a duty. It provides no location/event records.

The provided secondary lead [Liberty Times, 2026-07-21](https://news.ltn.com.tw/news/life/paper/1763640) could not be opened by the web tool. It is not treated as evidence.

## Finding and limit

Within this bounded check, I found **no primary dated official record** confirming removal or restoration at Raohe Night Market/Songshan Station exits; Nangang Station/Nangang Bus Station/Kunyang Station; Daan Forest Park perimeter; Youth Park; or Zhishan, Fulin, or Zhicheng parks. I found no primary record of event-specific reasons for these places. No count or date can be reported. These negative search results must not be used to infer removal from current inventory absence or neighborhood agreement.

Best next evidence source, for a future data request: a dated DEP or district cleaning-team maintenance/dispatch or installation-removal work-order register (and park management's corresponding park-bin work records for park sites), with site, action date, reason, and facility type. The public DEP FAQ identifies 1999/borough-chief request channels but does not itself provide those records. Keep park-management and other-agency bins separate from DEP pedestrian street bins.
